# Customer Story

`saas/customer-story` &middot; section-level &middot; category: saas

## Purpose

A short customer story: their logo, a quote, one headline result and a link to the full story.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `customer` | text |  |
| `quote` | text |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `logo` | image { src, alt } |  |
| `person` | text |  |
| `role` | text |  |
| `metric` | stat |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: A 480px column on the surface color.
- **tinted**: On the page background color. Sets `background: @colors.background`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `maxWidth` | length | `"480px"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Honored. | Fine. The logo alt text names the customer if images are blocked. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('saas/customer-story', {
  "customer": "Northwind Studio",
  "logo": {
    "src": "https://placehold.co/240x80/png?text=Northwind",
    "alt": "Northwind Studio"
  },
  "quote": "We moved 40 client projects over in a weekend and cut our status meetings in half.",
  "person": "Dana Whitfield",
  "role": "Head of Operations",
  "metric": {
    "value": "50%",
    "label": "fewer status meetings"
  },
  "cta": {
    "label": "Read the Northwind story",
    "href": "https://example.com/customers/northwind"
  }
}) ]]
```
